c48_hypothesis.name: Volume-of-Volume Shock Mean Reversion (Volatility-of-Liquidity Burst Fade)
c48_hypothesis.description: Compute vov = rolling_std(qvol, 24h) (second moment/dispersion of real quote volume), z-score over 168h (causal) -> vov_z. Fade extreme liquidity-instability shocks: vov_z >= 1.25 and ret_W>0 -> SHORT; vov_z >= 1.25 and ret_W<0 -> LONG. Extreme calm (vov_z <= -1.25) -> no entry (pre-stated asymmetry). Exit on vov_z < 0.25, max hold 12h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 trades high vol_z LEVEL (first-moment volume z) momentum continuation; C48 uses z-score of rolling STD of qvol (second-moment dispersion) as a shock fade.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH volume climax on aggregate vol_z level; C48 fades VOLATILITY-OF-VOLUME (dispersion) shocks — different transform (std of volume, not volume level).
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 continues on LOW vol_z dry-up breakout; C48 mean-reverts on extreme volume-dispersion shocks (high vov_z).
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms breakouts on volume expansion (level); C48 uses volume-dispersion (vov) shock fade, no breakout/expansion confirmation.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades volume-price divergence using unsloped vol_z at price extremes; C48 uses vov_z (dispersion of volume) shock with ret_W confirmation — different transform and trigger.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c44: C44 trend-follows on vol_z ROC acceleration; C48 mean-reverts on extreme vov_z dispersion shocks, no ROC/acceleration.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c45: C45 mean-reverts on Amihud illiquidity shocks (|ret|/volume, price-impact ratio); C48 uses rolling std of qvol (volume dispersion), not a price-impact ratio.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c46: C46 continues on OBV (cumulative sign*vol) slope divergence vs price slope; C48 uses vov_z dispersion shock fade — different transform (std of volume vs OBV slopes) and opposite mechanic.
c48_hypothesis.differs_from_c47: C47 uses up/down volume split imbalance ratio (directional partitioned sums) exhaustion fade; C48 uses rolling standard deviation of total qvol (undirected dispersion/second moment) — different construction entirely.
